easy.def: A word that shows where something goes.
examples: We walk to school.
I gave the ball to Mia.
The bus goes to the zoo.

more.def: A word that shows the place, person, or thing that something moves toward or is aimed at.
examples: The train travels from the city to the coast.
She wrote a letter to her grandfather.
Please listen to the instructions carefully.
I want to come too.
She likes pizza too.
Can I play too?

more.def: Also, or in addition to something that was just said.
examples: My brother plays the drums, and my sister plays them too.
I would like some juice too, please.
Frogs are amphibians, and toads are too.
The soup is too hot.
This box is too big.
It is too late.

more.def: More than is needed, wanted, or allowed.
examples: The coat was too small, so I gave it to my cousin.
It is too dark to read without a lamp.
Do not eat too much candy before dinner.

easy.def: A storm with wind that spins very fast.
examples: The tornado spun across the field.
We go to the basement in a tornado.
The tornado looked like a big gray cone.

more.def: A powerful storm with a spinning, funnel-shaped column of wind.
examples: The family hid in the basement until the tornado passed.
The tornado tore the roof off the barn.
A siren warns the town when a tornado is near.
